findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: choose_provider_for_task, get_agent_surfaces · Public sink: choose_provider_for_task, search_tools, get_provider, compare_providers, list_changes.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: choose_provider_for_task, get_agent_surfaces · Public sink: choose_provider_for_task, search_tools, get_provider, compare_providers, list_changes

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
